# Data

The following provides the full list of data that we will use this semester.  Some of the links below are to data posted on my website; others point to data hosted externally (if you notice any broken links, please let me know).

Note: some of the datasets below require installing an `R` package.  For example, to access the `Airq` data, you need to install the `Ecdat` package first (i.e., by running `install.packages("Ecdat")`) and then run `data(Airq, package="Ecdat")`.


- `acs`

    - Data from the 2019 American Community Survey about Education and Earnings

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `Airq`

    - Data about air quality in California counties in 1972.

    - Access: `data(Airq, package="Ecdat")`

    - Description: `?Ecdat::Airq`

- `AJR`

    - Data about GDP, institutions, and settler mortality

    - Access: `data(AJR, package="hdm")`

    - Description: `?hdm::AJR`

- `banks`

    - Data about bank closures in Mississippi during the Great Depression

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `Birthweight_Smoking`

    - Data about infant birthweights and mother's smoking from PA 1989

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Mark Watson's website](https://www.princeton.edu/~mwatson/Stock-Watson_3u/Students/EE_Datasets/Birthweight_Smoking_Description.pdf)

- `Caschool`

    - School-level test score data from California in 1998-1999

    - Access: `data(Caschool, package="Ecdat")`

    - Description: `?Ecdat::Caschool`

- `diamond_train`

    - Data about diamond prices.  The full version of this data I got from Kaggle, and then I split it into training and testing data.

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: A description of each column in the data is available under the `Description` tab on [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/shivam2503/diamonds/)

- `diamond_test`

    - Out of sample version of `diamond_train` data

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: A description of each column in the data is available under the `Description` tab on [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/shivam2503/diamonds/)

- `Fair`

    - Individual-level data about affairs in the United States

    - Access: `data(Fair, package="Ecdat")`

    - Description: `?Ecdat::Fair`

-  `fastfood`

    - Data about fast food restaurants in New Jersey and Pennsylvania from Card and Krueger (1994)

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `Fatalities`

    - State-level panel data about drunk driving laws and traffic fatalities

    - Access: `data(Fatality, package="AER")`

    - Description: `?AER::Fatality`

- `Fertility`

    - Data from Angrist and Evans (1998) about fertility and female labor supply

    - Access: `data(Fertility, package="AER")`

    - Description: `?AER::Fertility`

- `fertilizer_2000`

    - Country-level data about fertilizer and crop yields from the year 2000.  See description of `fertilizer_panel` below for more details

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `fertilizer_panel`

    - Country-level panel data from 1965-2000 (every 5 years) about fertilizer and crop yields for 68 developing countries.  This data is a smaller version of the data used in McArthur, John W., and Gordon C. McCord. "Fertilizing growth: Agricultural inputs and their effects in economic development." Journal of Development Economics 127 (2017): 133-152. url: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jdeveco.2017.02.007](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jdeveco.2017.02.007).

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `gapminder`

    - Country-level panel data from 1952-2007 about life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population

    - Access: `data(gapminder, package="gapminder")`

    - Description: `?gapminder::gapminder`

- `house`

    - U.S. House of Representatives elections data from 1946-1998

    - Access: Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `intergenerational_mobility`

    - Intergenerational mobility data from PSID

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `Lead_Mortality`

    - Infant mortality and lead pipes in 1900

    - Access: Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Mark Watson's website](http://www.princeton.edu/~mwatson/Stock-Watson_3u/Students/EE_Datasets/Lead_Mortality_Description.pdf)

- `mlda`

    - Car accident deaths by age group

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `mroz`

    - Labor force particpation of married women

    - Access: `data(mroz, package="wooldridge")`

    - Description: `?wooldridge::mroz`

- `mutual_funds`

    - Mutual fund performance data

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `rand_hie`

    - RAND health insurance experiment

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

- `Star`

    - Data from Project STAR that randomly assigned some students to smaller class sizes

    - Access: `data(Star, package="Ecdat")`

    - Description: `?Ecdat::Star`

- `titanic_training`

    - Passenger level data on surviving Titanic.  This data is a slightly adapted version of the `titanic` data on [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/c/titanic)

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/c/titanic/data)

- `titanic_testing`

    - Out of sample version of `titanic_training` data

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/c/titanic/data)

- `us_data`

    - Data from the 2019 American Community Survey via IPUMS

    - Access: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)

    - Description: [Course Website](`r course_website_link`)
